SELF_AUDIT.SCALABILITY_CURVE_EXPLANATION: GlobalQualityWeight is smoothed by SmoothUnit(t)=t*t*(3-2*t). math.step(0.3, quality) opens a low-quality cosmetic survival band only below 0.3; that band is then smoothed polynomially and blended with math.lerp. At 0.1, cosmeticScale collapses toward 0.00390625, SubBlockBytes moves toward a 12.5 percent floor before the 1024B safety clamp, WAL bytes-per-second approaches 12.5 percent of base retention, and CosmeticDeltaPayloadPruneJob drops cosmetic StateDeltaRecordDTO payloads once source bytes exceed the scaled threshold. The critical Merkle/CRC/XXHash/AUP truth path remains intact; only cosmetic WAL payload retention is shed. Pager enqueue no longer performs caller-thread WAL Flush(true) or Thread.Sleep backpressure; MicroSD pressure is absorbed by fixed vault ring capacity, dropped-write telemetry, and the background worker append/commit path.
